summary: Kyoto Sanga 2026/27 home shirt: Kyocera front (chest), Bank of Kyoto (right collarbone) and HORIBA (left collarbone), Wacoal on the left sleeve, Nintendo on the back, KDDI below the back number, and Daiwa Securities on the shorts, with Puma as kit supplier. All placements confirmed on the club's 2026-06-15 uniform sponsors announcement; the supplier is named on the club's uniform design announcement of the same day.
